bootstrap_unit.H2: event-scenario-horizon case, not raster cells; three event clusters only
bootstrap_unit.intervals_are: descriptive simulation sensitivity, not population inference

predeclared_outcome_directions.H2_interval_coverage: closer to nominal 0.90 is better; nominal coverage is diagnostic only
predeclared_outcome_directions.H2_interval_width_m: narrower is preferable only alongside coverage; do not rank alone
predeclared_outcome_directions.H3_H4_route_failure_fraction: lower is better among pairs with observed values
predeclared_outcome_directions.H3_H4_travel_time_seconds: lower is better among pairs with both routes found
predeclared_outcome_directions.H3_H4_depth_distance_exposure_m2: lower is better where both route outputs provide the same defined field
predeclared_outcome_directions.H3_H4_assessed_edge_coverage_fraction: higher is better, but coverage is reported separately

H2_definition.deterministic_reference: A05 member 12 (nominal Manning and infiltration multipliers 1.0/1.0), verified against its member metadata
H2_definition.uncertainty_interval: cellwise 5th to 95th percentiles of A05 members 1-19
H2_definition.valid_cells: only cells valid in both the forecast ensemble and held-out member; NoData remains excluded and counted

H3_H4_pairing.event_key: parsed from the registered scenario_key prefix; no synthetic event identifier

H5_counterfactual_selection.departure_shift: evaluate only if exact +/-1-hour graph snapshots and route outputs exist; never interpolate snapshots
H5_counterfactual_selection.bridge_edge: among bridge-flagged edges in saved static A09 paths, choose greatest path-use count, tie-break by smallest stable edge_id; report saved-path invalidation only unless a registered rerouting result exists
H5_counterfactual_selection.shelter_candidate: among A10 candidate_facilities with category shelter, choose greatest cumulative allocated_people_model_estimate, tie-break by smallest numeric OSM ID; remove its recorded allocation without redistribution; do not imply real availability
